props.text: Heat pump: a specialty tank with a hot and a cold side, badges and alert frame, display only.
Hydraulic separator: a specialty tank with badges and alert frame, display only.
Generator gauge: a dial with value, optional second value and setpoint marks, display only.
Motor and pump gauge: a dial with value, optional second value and setpoint marks, display only.
Valve gauge: the opening of a two-way or three-way valve as a dial, with setpoint marks, display only.
Hydraulic 4/3 valve: a three position selector showing the selected position, display only.
Hydraulic two position valve (2/2, 3/2 or 4/2): a selector showing the selected position, display only.
Transmitter button: a readout chip with a value and unit, optional advice and setpoint segments, or a tag pill, display only.
